title: Circular Measure Module 5 Lesson 2: Polygons with Circular Additions / Subtractions custom practice

parts.prompt: A composite plate consists of a square of side $4\text{ cm}$ with a semicircle attached externally on one side (with diameter $4\text{ cm}$). Find the exact total area of the plate in terms of $\pi$.
A composite plate consists of a square of side $4\text{ cm}$ with a semicircle attached externally along one of its sides. Find the exact outer perimeter of the plate.
A rectangle of length $8\text{ cm}$ and width $4\text{ cm}$ has a semicircular notch of diameter $4\text{ cm}$ removed from one of its short ends. Find the exact remaining area of the plate.

In an equilateral triangle, each interior angle is $\dfrac{\pi}{3}\text{ radians}$. A circular sector of radius $3\text{ cm}$ is removed from each of the $3$ vertices. Find the exact total area of the three removed sectors combined.
A rectangle of dimensions $10\text{ cm}$ by $6\text{ cm}$ has a quadrant of radius $2\text{ cm}$ removed from each of its $4$ corners. Find the exact total boundary length of the resulting plate.
A regular hexagon of side $6\text{ cm}$ is composed of $6$ equilateral triangles of side $6\text{ cm}$. Find the exact area of the regular hexagon in terms of $\sqrt{3}$.
A square of side $6$ cm has a semicircle drawn externally on one side as diameter. Find the area and outside perimeter of the combined plate.
